Description: Permanent erosion site identifier — assigned by data manager; never changes
QC_Rule: No duplicates; no nulls; format must follow pattern; stable across all updates

Description: Nearest community identifier — assigned via spatial join (SJ12); not manually entered
QC_Rule: Must resolve to DB01 Community_ID; no nulls; populated after spatial join

Description: GPS latitude of erosion site centroid or head-scarp in decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds; must be within 10km of parent community

Description: GPS longitude of erosion site centroid or head-scarp in decimal degrees WGS84
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be within Nigeria bounds

Description: GPS horizontal accuracy in metres
QC_Rule: No nulls; flag >30m; reject >100m

Description: Primary erosion type code
QC_Rule: No nulls; must resolve to LKP_ErosionType.csv

Description: Whether erosion site is currently active
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only

Description: Erosion severity on 0–4 scale
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be 0–4 integer; must resolve to LKP_ErosionSeverity.csv

Description: Erosion feature length in metres (longest axis)
QC_Rule: If present must be >0; flag >5000m for verification; NULL if not measured

Description: Erosion feature width in metres (widest point)
QC_Rule: If present must be >0; flag >1000m; NULL if not measured

Description: Erosion feature depth in metres (deepest point)
QC_Rule: If present must be >0; flag >50m for verification; NULL if not measured

Description: Distance from erosion site to nearest river in metres
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; populated from GIS (SJ04 variant); NULL if not calculated

Allowed_Values: Flat (<2%), Gentle (2-5%), Moderate (5-15%), Steep (15-30%), Very Steep (>30%), Unknown
Description: General slope class at erosion site
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NULL permitted

Description: Predominant soil type at site (field observation)
QC_Rule: Free text; standardise in CLEAN version

Description: Vegetation cover at site (field observation)
QC_Rule: Free text; standardise in CLEAN version

Description: Drainage condition at site (field observation)
QC_Rule: Free text; standardise in CLEAN version

Description: Land use at or adjacent to erosion site
QC_Rule: Free text; standardise in CLEAN version

Description: Whether erosion threatens identifiable infrastructure
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only

Description: IDs of infrastructure items threatened — linked to DB06
QC_Rule: If present must resolve to DB06 Infrastructure_ID values; populated after DB06 built

Description: Whether erosion site delivers sediment directly to river
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Whether any erosion control measures are present at site
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Description of control measures if present
QC_Rule: Free text

Allowed_Values: Good, Fair, Poor, Failed, NA, Unknown
Description: Condition of control measures if present
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NA if Control_Present = No

Description: Date erosion site was observed/measured in field
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date; must be >= 2026-01-01; not future

Description: Reference IDs of site photographs
QC_Rule: If present must have corresponding files in 02_Fieldwork/Photos/

Description: Field observer name or code
QC_Rule: No nulls; used for QC

Description: Field team notes
QC_Rule: Review before publication

Description: Date record entered into database
QC_Rule: Auto-populated; no nulls

Description: Date record last modified
QC_Rule: Auto-populated on update

Description: Data version
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Processing status
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv
